antidote.desc: Restores 10 health and lifts the spirits a little.
antidote.name: Flameclear Dew

bread.desc: Restores 15 health. Something for the road.
bread.name: Dry Rations

hunt_core.desc: Rare hunting ground core. Best price at the surplus buyback.
hunt_core.name: Spill Core

hunt_hide.desc: Hunting ground material. Trade it at the surplus buyback.
hunt_hide.name: Spill Hide

iron_scrap.desc: Basic forging material. Both the smith and the shop buy it.
iron_scrap.name: Scrap Iron

key_rusty.desc: The one you picked up at the village gate. Kept even after it was forged proper.
key_rusty.name: Rusty Sword (keepsake)

knight_shard.desc: A forging fragment from the knights' domain. Makes the sabre line.
knight_shard.name: Knight Iron Shard

map_scrap.desc: A corner the trader tore off for you. Good to look at, not to eat.
map_scrap.name: Six-Domain Map Scrap

mist_shard.desc: Dropped by mist shades. Sells for 12 gold.
mist_shard.name: Mist Crystal

oak_resin.desc: Material for stabilising and for accessories.
oak_resin.name: Oak Resin

relic_token.desc: A mark left from clearing a hidden place. For the collection.
relic_token.name: Secret Place Token

scar_ember.desc: Dropped in the scar. Sells for 15 gold.
scar_ember.name: Scar Ember

sea_shell.desc: Found on the coast. Sells for 10 gold.
sea_shell.name: Tide Shell

star_ore.desc: Material for star reading and Starpath weapons.
star_ore.name: Star Sand Ore
